name: LIBERTY
description: LIBERTY is a single-use, remotely operated endovascular robotic system developed by [Microbot Medical](/company/microbot_medical) for peripheral vascular interventions. Rather than a floor-standing capital console, the system pairs a disposable robotic drive unit mounted at the procedure table with a handheld wireless remote controller, enabling linear and rotational manipulation of standard off-the-shelf microcatheters, guidewires, and embolic devices from outside the primary radiation field. Evaluated in the multicenter ACCESS-PVI feasibility study for arterial peripheral vascular interventions—including prostatic artery embolization, uterine fibroid embolization, genicular artery embolization, and Y-90 radioembolization mapping—LIBERTY received US FDA 510(k) clearance in September 2025 and entered full US commercial release in April 2026.
